.claude-plugin/plugin.json.why: Two version lines. This repository's marketplace (ADR 0044) versions the plugin it serves, and the incubator assigns its own on promotion. Everything else in the manifest must match.

.claude-plugin/deploys.json.why: Deleted here by ADR 0058, which moved each gate's contract into skills/<gate>/deploys.json. ee-skills keeps this file because the incubator's promote.py never syncs .claude-plugin/ on an amendment, so it stays at gate-secrets contract 6 indefinitely. Nothing reads it: register-check refuses a plugin that has only this file. Removing it upstream would be a hand change, and is not owed.

skills/*/deploys.json.why: ADR 0058: each gate declares its contract in its own directory, because a promotion copies skill directories wholesale and never copies .claude-plugin/. Not yet submitted; one incubator amendment carries all six.

README.md.why: Rewritten here for adopters (submission 16, incubator#1178, merged upstream in incubator#1184). promote.py's amend path skips _NATIVE_PRESERVE ({.claude-plugin, data, LICENSE, README.md}) as managed in ee-skills, so the incubator's copy reached ee-skills only by hand: incubator#1185, applied as ee-skills#1435 (11280c1). The one difference left is the Deployment contract paragraph, which names skills/<gate>/deploys.json since ADR 0058. It goes upstream with the ADR 0058 submission, and needs a second hand copy unless incubator#1186 (the promote.py root cause) lands first.

skills/gate-*/SKILL.md.why: ADR 0058 moved each gate's contract into skills/<gate>/deploys.json, and this SKILL.md now names that file: the GATE_CONTRACT row in a gate, or the shared canonical-source paragraph. Not yet submitted. It also differs by the docs link, which is by-design; once the submission ships, re-record and fold this back into one by-design skills/*/SKILL.md entry.
